title: Warmth, texture and character
copy: An independent 2025 composition exploring Tobacco Vanille through warm sand, tobacco tones and atmosphere.

title: The leaf rises first
copy: The tobacco leaf rises first above the sand.

title: The smoke follows
copy: The smoke rises into a separate sheet above the leaf.

title: The bottle comes last
copy: The bottle rises last and stays brightest while earlier sheets darken.

title: A warm material palette
copy: The owner identifies #A88046, #E0A725, #31251B and #3B261E as the palette linking bottle, tobacco, sand and atmosphere.

title: Back to the original
copy: The layers return to the owner-supplied assembled artwork. Independent portfolio work, not an official brand campaign.
